description: Dataset of "Smart Grids Transmission Network Testbed: Design, Deployment, and Beyond is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Petr Mlýnek, Radek Fujdiak (Brno University of Technology). Our test environment incorporates a unique blend of physical, emulated, and virtualizedcomponents, spanning from electrical substations to SCADA systems,thereby offering a versatile platform for testing against cyber threats, facilitatingeducational programs, and supporting advanced traffic simulation. Key findingsfrom our deployment highlight the testbed’s effectiveness in identifying vulnerabilities,enhancing cybersecurity measures, and providing valuable hands-onlearning experiences. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
